claims.statement: The pinned Code Quality supported-language list contains CSharp, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, Ruby and TypeScript. Listing support is not exhaustive query coverage, current engine compatibility, installed scanning or language-specific enforcement.

The dashboard All findings step expands a templated view group and selects the templated all-findings view. The label does not prove complete scan population, successful analysis, pagination or absence of suppressed/inaccessible findings.
Repository dashboard navigation selects the templated Security and Quality tab. Tab existence or navigation guidance is not effective scanning, permissions or observed repository state.
The dashboard Recent suggestions step selects a templated recent-suggestions view. Recent suggestions are not all findings, applied fixes or verified remediation; no dashboard was accessed.

The source describes licensed Copilot PR-comment delegation, eyes-emoji acknowledgment, a new agent session and a resulting fix PR, tracked through summaries or agent/session pages. Acknowledgment is not successful execution or correctness; live session/run evidence and reviewed fixes are required. License is a prerequisite, not a cost or mutation grant. Screenshot caption and marketing/signup links are recorded but raster and linked pages are not reviewed; no agent was invoked.

Assigning an individual dashboard finding to Copilot consumes AI credits and leads to a draft fix PR requiring review. Credit consumption makes invocation a cost-bearing action needing applicable approval; generated draft code is not an accepted, merged or behavior-verified remediation.
